recap.paragraph: Devon Dampier threw 2 touchdown passes as No. 2 Utah beat TCU 38-17. He hit Braden Pegan for a 68-yard score. Utah led 17-0 at halftime, but Jeremy Payne ran for 2 touchdowns. His second score tied the game at 17! Hunter Andrews put Utah ahead with a 2-yard touchdown run. Then Dampier zipped an 85-yard touchdown pass to Larry Simmons! Utah stayed the only unbeaten FBS team and stretched its winning streak to 17 games. The win also sent Utah to the Big 12 Championship Game.
